name: robots/dyson-ai__grip
title: Grip PickAndPlaceEnvironment (pybullet)
intro: Grip PickAndPlaceEnvironment (pybullet), adapted from dyson-ai/grip. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset_world` and `fence`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/dyson-ai__grip --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/dyson-ai__grip --backend fake --mcp
